US President Donald Trump says negotiations with Iran are “going fine” but claims that he’s “not in that much of a hurry” to make a deal.
Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says talks are ongoing with Qatari mediators on a plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if the US cooperates.
